workflows.name: Checkout

invariants.statement: Exact replay creates at most one reward

evidence.detail: Final checkout_probe.py counterexample produced two rewards for one request.

invariants.statement: Request identity binds to customer and amount

evidence.detail: Counterexamples accepted changed customer and amount against the original order.

invariants.statement: Reward failure leaves neither new order nor reward

unknowns: Concurrent requests were not checked in this read-only audit

candidates.title: Own local checkout consistency and request identity
candidates.reason: All three documented guarantees have concrete counterexamples.
candidates.counterargument: The existing checkout public function is already narrow; no new public service is needed. Preserve helper clients and establish transaction ownership before moving commits.
candidates.possible_contract: Keep checkout(db, request_id, customer, cents) -> {order_id}; let one persistence operation own local atomic writes and exact-retry comparison.
candidates.test_implication: Real SQLite regression tests should assert rows, response equality, changed-payload rejection and rollback/recovery after injected reward failure.
candidates.next_step: Add the demonstrated regressions in an explicitly approved disposable copy before implementing.
